title: registry.go feature flag Generate field co-changes with openfeature.gen files
answers: What else needs to change when I edit a feature flag in registry.go?
Do I need to touch the openfeature.gen files manually?
Feature toggle generated files out of sync
body: Editing the `Generate` field of a flag in pkg/services/featuremgmt/registry.go (e.g. adding React: true) requires regenerating packages/grafana-runtime/src/internal/openFeature/openfeature.gen.ts and openfeature-types.gen.d.ts, which add the flag to FlagKeys and produce a useFlagX hook/type union entry. These .gen files are generated — don't hand-edit them outside running the generator, but do commit the resulting diff alongside the registry.go change.
applies: Any change to a feature flag's Generate options or metadata in registry.go.
